principle: Apply every v14 review note while enforcing one exact low-contrast palette across the entire round. The only background-graphic endpoints are #f0eee9 and #f7f5ef; candidates may exchange their roles or interpolate between them but may not introduce a third neutral. Number motion remains planar and coordinated, columns bleed beyond the frame, wipe fields abandon visible rows and columns, and all parameters remain reproducible.

recipes.name: Dense overlapping loop — fixed palette
recipes.description: The accepted dense overlapping construction keeps its 420 balanced, bold, equal-size digits and closed one-quarter-magnitude path. Its only graphic colors are #f0eee9 and #f7f5ef.

recipes.name: Extra-slow columns with edge bleed
recipes.description: Close bold columns move together at less than half the v14 magnitude. Digit centers sit on every frame boundary so partial columns visibly continue beyond all four edges; contrast is limited to #f0eee9 against #f7f5ef.

recipes.name: Extra-slow columns — palette reversed
recipes.description: The same edge-bleeding coordinated columns exchange the two exact palette roles: #f7f5ef digits on #f0eee9. Motion remains uniformly extra slow.

recipes.name: Reversed curtain — fixed palette
recipes.description: The horizontal reversed-color curtain now uses only #f0eee9 and #f7f5ef, placing its movement at the edge of conscious notice.

recipes.name: Top-to-bottom curtain — fixed palette
recipes.description: The vertical curtain keeps its top-to-bottom path while reducing the entire event to the #f0eee9 and #f7f5ef contrast interval.

recipes.name: 31-degree curtain — fixed palette
recipes.description: The reproducible 31-degree curtain retains its direction but uses only the fixed low-contrast pair #f0eee9 and #f7f5ef.

recipes.name: One-way panel — gentle acceleration
recipes.description: The panel begins slowly and accelerates through one 11-second crossing using a 1.7-power rhythm. Its two endpoints are exactly #f7f5ef and #f0eee9 before the abrupt light reset.

recipes.name: One-way panel — stronger acceleration
recipes.description: A second rhythm comparison holds the exact palette constant and delays more motion until late in the video with a stronger 2.6-power acceleration before the abrupt light reset.

recipes.name: Soft-edge accelerating door
recipes.description: The hinged door retains its slow-start, fast-finish opening but softens its edge substantially. Door and background are restricted to #f0eee9 and #f7f5ef.

recipes.name: Irregular static-number wipe
recipes.description: Balanced equal-size digits are scattered deterministically without visible rows or columns and remain still while the right-to-left wipe accelerates. All background graphics use only the fixed subtle palette.

recipes.name: Opposing irregular number wipe
recipes.description: The irregular equal-size number field moves right as one plane while the accelerating wipe travels from right to left, creating opposing directions without depth or excess contrast.
